angles.angle: People who plan the biggest change quit soonest, because one missed day breaks the whole plan [VERIFY].
angles.visual: A giant plan card cracks on day three.

angles.angle: A two-minute version survives a bad day, so the streak never resets.
angles.visual: A tiny card slides under a falling big one.

angles.angle: Every reset costs the motivation the plan was meant to build.
angles.visual: A motivation meter drains at each reset.

angles.angle: Discipline is not the missing ingredient most people think it is.
angles.visual: The word discipline is struck out.

angles.angle: Most people blame their character, not the size of the plan.
angles.visual: A mirror label flips from me to plan.

angles.angle: Habit apps reward long streaks, which punishes the small days that matter.
angles.visual: A streak counter mocks a one-minute day.
